name: unb-site
description: unbgroup.uz — static site. Node is only used to build the HTML decks from the source PDFs.

scripts.build: npm run build:pages && npm run build:deck-mobile && npm run build:deck-pages && npm run build:sitemap
scripts.schema: npx wrangler d1 execute unb-leads --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --file worker/schema.sql
scripts.leads: npx wrangler d1 execute unb-leads --remote --config worker/wrangler.toml --command "SELECT id, created_at, name, phone, direction_label, lang, status FROM leads ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20"
